description.en: The ID of the Prometheus instance.
The name of the monitoring configuration.

description.zh:
容器服务类型的实例支持：serviceMonitor、podMonitor、customJob、probe。
ecs类型的实例支持：customJob、probe。
description.en:
The type of the monitoring configuration. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for Container Service: serviceMonitor, podMonitor, customJob, and probe. 
Valid values for a Prometheus instance for ECS: customJob and probe.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms get-prometheus-monitoring --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --type customJob --monitoring-name customJob1 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms GetPrometheusMonitoring --region cn-hangzhou --Type customJob --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --MonitoringName customJob1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
